qualification.details: Research Fellow: Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering with specialization in Instrumentation Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering, or related engineering disciplines. Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience.
Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email.
Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification.
Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 21-08-2026.
Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Research Fellow position at NIT Rourkela?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Research Fellow position at NIT Rourkela is 21st August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum educational qualifications required for the Research Fellow role?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering or a related field, or an M.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering with at least 60% marks, or a B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering with a GATE score and specific CGPA/marks.

faq.question: Q3. What is the maximum age limit for the Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Fellow position is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q4. How will candidates be selected for the Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial shortlisting of candidates based on their eligibility criteria, followed by an interview, which may be conducted online or offline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 57,000/- per month for Ph.D. holders and Rs. 42,000/- per month for M.Tech. holders.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email to the specified address: [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q8. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is NITR/SR/2026/Advt.-26SC5022 / L/070.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: This is a project-based job opportunity at NIT Rourkela.

faq.question: Q10. What is the official website of NIT Rourkela?
faq.answer: The official website of the National Institute of Technology Rourkela is www.nitrkl.ac.in, where you can find more information.
